findings.passage: Argabright and Barrett are both in favor of the legislation, with Argabright saying the issue for him comes down to “mail delivery” as the main factor.
findings.note: KVOE report of a local legislative forum. It says he favours Senate Bill 4, which ends the three-day grace period for returning mail ballots (deadline 7 pm on election night), and gives his reason as mail delivery. The outlet's audio clip (argabright-mail.mp3) holds his words; I did not listen to it. Only the two words in quotation marks are directly his. Mail ballot rules, not ID.
